evidence.summary: Slice 3: auto-commit primitive (_maybe_commit_bookkeeping in git_ops.py) wired into all 7 state-mutating task.py functions (record_builder, record_reviewer, close, reopen, waive_review, record_triage, record_escalation) via a --defer-commit CLI flag on each. git_ops.commit()'s own internal call to record_builder hardcodes defer=True to avoid a second commit immediately after the code commit it just made. A live bug found and fixed during dogfooding: the first version swept ANY dirty content into the auto-commit and labeled it chore(codev-bookkeeping) regardless of content, which (via this repo's own editable install picking up in-progress source edits) mislabeled slice 3's own real feature code as bookkeeping in an early attempt. Fixed: _maybe_commit_bookkeeping now only fires when every dirty path is confined to the task's own .codev/task/<id>/ directory; anything else dirty is a no-op, leaving it for a deliberate commit -- exactly what this commit now is.

All 7 task.py functions gained defer parameters and call the shared helper. git_ops.commit()'s internal record_builder call hardcodes defer=True, confirmed by reading the exact line. All 7 CLI subcommands gained --defer-commit, confirmed by reading cli.py's diff directly.
